scenarios.prompt: A tap-parry and an incoming strike become active on the same logical tick. Define window, guard arc, priority and resulting attacker/defender states.

criteria.ownership: Owns guard/parry windows, arcs and reaction rules; dodge invulnerability and poise remain separate.
criteria.ordering: Same-tick contact and defense transitions use an explicit deterministic priority rule.
criteria.evidence: Boundary and attack-class tests show logical outcomes without relying on flash/audio.
